name: Juunibayashi Kanon
source:
The mysterious girl that is at the center of all of this. [spoiler][url=/c15885]Timothy[/url] pulls her out of time when she falls off the roof, to prevent [url=/c15887]Derek[/url] from killing himself. Both [url=/c6258]Ethan[/url] and [url=/c15887]Derek[/url] have feelings for her.[/spoiler] Being pulled out of time, she also gets flashbacks and can move when time holes are open.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_Hollow]wikipedia[/url]]
